method.decode: every integer scalar column of every table decoded for all rows (t133 verified grammars); vector slots merged into logical fields; branch- and vector-index-free canonical column identity
method.domains: exact ordinal/uid key sets per table, plus canonical per-class domains (server archive preferred) and the basic_people person domain
promotion: code_corroborated: 4CC/L3 field name token, adjacent (ordinal,uid) or (uid,dbid) reference pair, or C DATABASE_OBJECT_REF slot evidence
statistical: uid target, support coverage <= 0.02, uniform_chance <= 1e-02, distinct >= 25
everything else stays ambiguous (enum guard: a <=24 value column never becomes a CONTINENT/AGREEMENT edge)
caveats: 8-byte references carry (uid u32, dbid u32); dbid == uid for same-database objects and 0 for cross-database person references
person references resolve only against the trimmed basic_people table (658,011 rows), the full roster lives in people_db.dat (out of scope)
t24 NATIONAL_TEAM is the generic TEAM table: it holds clubs as well as national teams (club uids are a subset of team uids)
ordinal-keyed foreign keys cannot be proven statistically because ordinal domains are dense 0..N-1; they are only promoted with code corroboration
